_comment: Independent handwritten source records. Ordinary typed updates own their exact assignments; unknown records, standalone and inline comments, multiline values and foreign siblings retain their complete bytes. Windows adds its existing canonical UTF-8 BOM. The quoted literal-dot update explicitly records the existing Lua refusal boundary; Windows retains its independently tested canonical writable contract. Retained spans do not require a new owned row to occupy any fixed insertion point.
